summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical details of function execution types in a database context, specifically comparing `executable` vs. `executable_pool`. It was clarified that while `executable_pool` might allow for server-side parallelization, functions generally run once per row and return a scalar value.

Performance testing revealed significant latency: an empty function took 17ms on the server but 75ms when tested via DBeaver from a local machine. This suggests that even after resolving library issues, real-world execution time might remain in the 70–90ms range.
decisions: The observed performance (70-90ms) is deemed acceptable as it is comparable to HTTP request latency.
